post.title: FutureMe went paid. Haku is free.
post.caption: Two fresh grudges: letters to your future self without the FutureMe paywall, and file recovery without paying for commercial software.

segments.gripe: Letters to yourself. Now with a paywall.
segments.quote: I spent about ten years writing to my future self with FutureMe. When it went paid, I built the app I wanted to keep using.
